mentions.name: Bowerjack
mentions.description: This invite-only web app uses AI to create custom subject playing cards on any theme: users drop in their own art or have their AI agent research creative commons/public domain art that is allowed to be printed, then download print sheets to cut locally on a Cricut or order from online playing card vendors. Planned expansion covers other paper goods with many individual elements such as 12-month and 365-day calendars, field guides, affirmation cards, and tarot cards. Development focuses on token efficiency, documented in a whitepaper comparing token, time, and cost efficiency of different approaches.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://bowerjack.com - make subject playing cards with AI (eventually: multiple types of paper goods where we have a lot of individual elements, like 12-month and 365-day calendars, field guides, affirmation cards, tarot cards, etc) Create a deck of cards on any theme, drop art yourself or have your AI agent research and find creative commons/public domain art that's allowed to be printed, and download sheets to print locally and cut on your Cricut, or order from one of a few online playing card vendors. Currently invite-only.
mentions.author: jerkstate
